webhooks.detail: Notifications API: create destination (Amazon EventBridge or SQS), subscribe to notification types (ORDER_CHANGE, ANY_OFFER_CHANGED, etc.). Push via AWS queues, not HTTP webhooks.

evidence.quote: Instead of polling for information, your application can receive information directly from Amazon

sandbox.detail: Static (mock) and dynamic sandbox endpoints; register a sandbox application. Page states no price. Sandbox throttle 5 req/s, burst 15. Needs SP-API developer registration.

evidence.quote: Use the SP-API sandbox to make test calls.

rate_limits.summary: Token bucket per operation per seller+app pair; per-operation rate/burst in API reference; standard (static) and dynamic plans; 429 on throttle

evidence.quote: The SP-API uses the token bucket algorithm to rate-limit requests to the API.
SP-API offers a collection of software development kits (SDKs) to connect with our APIs.
This repository contains Swagger models for developers to use to create software that calls Selling Partner APIs.
